Subject: StellarNet vendor credentials & PO-owner mapping

Hi Tom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to move StellarNet onto Redwood for inference. To get the vendor record live in our procurement system and route POs correctly, we need a short packet from you: legal entity name, W-9 (if US), primary invoice email, AP contact name + phone, and bank details (for ACH).

Two quick asks so we can avoid delays on the finance side:
- Please confirm the legal entity exactly as it appears on tax forms.
- Tell us which internal contact should be the default PO owner (name + email) — this is where purchase orders will be sent before routing to AP.

I attached a sample PO-routing spreadsheet we use internally and a one-page checklist. If convenient, reply with the W-9 and bank sheet as attachments. If you prefer, send a single consolidated PDF.

Goal: have vendor record created and first PO routable by next Wednesday (2025-11-12).

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: PO-routing-template.xlsx (sample), onboarding-checklist.pdf (sample)

Tom — great, appreciate the quick turnaround. CC'ing Hannah (Finance Ops) and Karthik (Legal intake) to flag two items so we get the vendor master set exactly how your team expects.

Hannah/Karthik — please review the items Tom listed and confirm the required fields for our ERP ingestion. Key points for quick alignment:
- Remit address vs. legal address: if they differ we need both. 1099/remit will follow the legal address unless otherwise specified by tax.
- W-9 receipt and verification: if the W-9 returns an EIN mismatch we'll loop legal.
- PO owner mapping: we'll set the default PO to route to Tom. Ellis but will include Maria Gomez on invoice routing as AP contact.

Tom — when you send the attachments, please name them exactly as: StellarNet_W9.pdf and StellarNet_Bank-Details.xlsx. That helps our automated ingestion. Also, if you have a company payment terms doc (net30/45) include it so the contracts team can pick up any special terms.

If everything arrives today we'll provision the vendor record tomorrow morning and push a shadow PO to Tom for validation before any live orders.

Best,
Sean
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
